name: Gambling Subdomain (Luck Subdomain)
body:
Associated domain: Luck

Replacement power: The following power replaces the good fortune power of the luck domain.

Grifting (Su)

At 6th level, whenever you use a magical item or spell which has some sort of random outcome), you can roll a Bluff check (DC 10 + the level of the spell or magic item) in order to re-roll or redraw an unfavorable outcome.

Replacement Domain Spells: 1st: entropic shield, 7th: prismatic spray
